main_text.p: tutum, qui & corporum & animarum nostrarum est conditor, ut eundem in Deo & secundum Deum teneamus, & in eo collocati, pie, iuste & sobrie viuamus, ut Dominus Deus hic & in futuro seculo benedictionem suam nobis largiatur per Christum Iesum: cui sit honor & gloria in sempiternum, Amen.
main_text.head: CONCIO XXXIIII.
Eccles. 9.

p.i: Uxorem quam complecteris, ne prosequaris zelotypia, nec eā malam in te arte doceas. Nec permittas animum tuum mulieri adeò, ut pessundet potestatem tuam, (tuq; dedecus incurras) Mulieri meretrici ne te des obuiam, ne forte in laqueos eius incidas. Cantatricem mulierem ne frequentes (nec audias) ne forte conatibus eius capiaris. Ne contempleris virginem, ut ne noxam ex precioso ipsius cultu contrahas. Ne appellas animum tuum ad meretrices, ne perdas (te simul &) tuam possessionem. In vicis urbis ne circumspectes, nec in secretis eius locis ober-res. page.notes: The woodcut initial is a V-shaped capital, read as the initial of the first word "Uxorem" (printed "Xorem"). Printed u/v spelling changed as per the rules. Three small ornamental marks stand in the right margin at the height of the text lines; these are not text, so no notes are transcribed. A small "O" appears alone below the last line, in the right-hand area; it is not a word, so it is left out. The line "alie-" ends a word with a printed hyphen; the rest of the word is on the next page. The "f" in "Ecclef." is the long s and is read as "Eccles.".
